title: Workspace settings
description: Manage the profile, members, keys, billing and data of {{workspace}}.

workspaceForm.name: Workspace name
workspaceForm.slugChangeWarning: Links that use the current URL will stop working.
workspaceForm.slugAuto: Generated from the name. If it's taken, a short suffix is added.
workspaceForm.slugInvalid: Use 3 to 48 lowercase letters, numbers or hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or a number.
workspaceForm.slugTaken: This URL is already taken. Try another one.
workspaceForm.slugUnavailable: We couldn't find a free URL for this name. Customize it.

general.profileDescription: The name and address everyone in this workspace sees.
general.readOnly: Only admins and the owner can change these settings.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.description: These actions change who controls this workspace, or remove it.
danger.transferBody: Make another member the owner. You'll stay in the workspace as an admin.
danger.transferOnlyOwner: Only the owner can transfer ownership.
danger.transferNoCandidate: Ownership goes to an existing member: invite someone first.
danger.transferDialogBody: The new owner can delete the workspace and manage everyone's access. You'll become an admin.
danger.transferRequired: Choose the member who'll own the workspace.
danger.leaveBody: You'll lose access to this workspace until someone invites you again.
danger.leaveOwner: A workspace always has an owner: transfer ownership before leaving.
danger.leaveDialogBody: You'll lose access to its agents, executions and settings right away. An admin can invite you back.
danger.deleteBody: Permanently deletes the workspace with its invitations and service keys, for every member.
danger.deleteOnlyOwner: Only the owner can delete this workspace.
danger.deleteDialogBody: Everything in this workspace is removed for every member. This can't be undone.

roles.owner: Full control, including deletion and ownership transfer.
roles.admin: Manages members, invitations, providers and service keys.
roles.member: Builds agents and tools, and runs executions.

members.title: Members
members.description: People who can access this workspace, and what they can do.
members.name: Name
members.ownerHint: The owner's role changes through an ownership transfer.
members.selfHint: You can't change your own role.
members.removeDialogBody: They'll lose access immediately. You can invite them again later.
members.readOnly: Only admins and the owner can change roles or remove members.

invite.title: Invite people
invite.description: They'll get an e-mail with a link to join, valid for 7 days.
invite.duplicate: This address is already in the list.
invite.alreadyMember: Already a member of this workspace.
invite.pending: An invitation is already pending for this address.
invite.failed: Couldn't send this invitation. Try again.
invite.noPermission: Only admins and the owner can invite people.

invitations.title: Pending invitations
invitations.description: Invitations that haven't been accepted yet.
invitations.emptyBody: Invitations you send appear here until they're accepted.
invitations.revokeDialogBody: The link in their e-mail stops working. You can invite them again later.

apiKeys.title: Service keys
apiKeys.description: Keys let scripts and CI call the Gouvra API for this workspace, with the role you choose.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.emptyBody: Create a key to call the API from scripts, CI or other services. Each key has its own role and can be revoked at any time.
apiKeys.noPermissionTitle: Service keys are managed by admins
apiKeys.noPermissionBody: Ask an admin or the owner of this workspace if you need a key.
apiKeys.createDescription: Name it after what will use it, and give it only the role it needs.
apiKeys.revealBody: Store it in a secret manager now. For your security, you won't be able to see it again.
apiKeys.revokeDialogBody: Anything using this key loses access immediately. This can't be undone.
apiKeys.loadError: Service keys are unavailable right now.

errors.owner_immutable: The owner's role changes only through an ownership transfer.
errors.self_role_change: You can't change your own role.
errors.owner_cannot_leave: Transfer ownership before leaving this workspace.
errors.invalid_target: Choose another member as the new owner.

limits.title: Execution limits
limits.description: How many executions of this workspace may run at the same time. The others wait in the queue.
limits.invalid: Enter a whole number between 1 and {{max}}.
limits.readOnly: Only admins and the owner can change limits.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Who did what in this workspace, and when. Entries can't be edited or deleted.
audit.end: That's the beginning of this workspace's history.
audit.emptyBody: Changes to this workspace — members, keys, providers, agents — will be listed here.
audit.emptyFilteredBody: Choose another filter, or show all events.
audit.noPermissionTitle: The audit log is for admins
audit.noPermissionBody: Ask an admin or the owner of this workspace if you need to review its history.
audit.loadError: The audit log is unavailable right now.
